summary: A draft influencer campaign proposal dated 26 May 2026 (SOURCE-DOCS.md lists it as 28 May) between Felici Artisan Gelato and the KarJack tandem, DJ Kara (Klariz Magboo, 3,688,000 total reach) and Papa Jack (John Gemperle, 2,069,000 total reach). The theme is 'Cold Gelato In Summer. Masarap pag may ka share', shot in one production day on-site at the Felici branch, delivering one Instagram/Facebook reel, one social media post and two Instagram stories. Talent fees are ₱40,000 each (₱80,000 total) plus ₱5,000 for production (photography, video, editing). The fee table names the second talent 'Papa Jackson' while the rest of the document says 'Papa Jack'. It is signed by a KarJack talent representative and Felici Artisan Gelato; both blocks are blank and ADVO is not a named party.
